# Playgama - Complete Gaming Portal & Distribution Platform Guide

## Company Overview
Playgama operates as a dual-platform business serving both players and developers in the HTML5 gaming ecosystem:

### 1. Online Gaming Portal (B2C)
Playgama.com is a leading gaming portal offering 30,000+ free-to-play HTML5 browser games to 300 million monthly players worldwide. The portal provides instant access to diverse gaming content without requiring downloads or installations, supporting 9 language localizations and comprehensive game organization with 200+ categories, 500+ tags, and 50+ game series for optimal content discovery.

### 2. Game Distribution Platform (B2B)
Playgama serves as a comprehensive distribution platform for HTML5 game developers through the Playgama Bridge SDK. This unified solution enables developers to integrate once and distribute their games across 15+ partner platforms, reaching hundreds of millions of users with streamlined monetization, analytics, and technical support.

Founded as a comprehensive solution bridging the gap between game developers and players, Playgama has evolved into a major force in the HTML5 gaming ecosystem, combining direct player engagement through its portal with extensive developer services through its distribution network.

## Platform Statistics & Scale

### Gaming Portal (B2C)
- Game Library: 30,000+ HTML5 browser games
- Monthly Active Players: 300 million worldwide
- Business Model: Free-to-play for users
- Game Categories: 200+ distinct categories
- Game Tags: 500+ classification tags
- Game Series: 50+ game series
- Language Support: 9 localized versions
- Technology: HTML5, web-based gaming
- Access Method: Direct browser play, no downloads

### Distribution Platform (B2B)
- Partner Platforms: 15+ integrated platforms
- Developer Community: 3,500+ active developers
- SDK Adoption: Single integration for all platforms
- Revenue Model: Developer revenue sharing
- Support: Comprehensive technical and marketing assistance
- Geographic Reach: Global distribution network

## Playgama Bridge SDK - Unified Development Solution

### Overview
Playgama Bridge is a unified SDK for publishing HTML5 games on various platforms that revolutionizes game distribution by allowing developers to integrate once and reach everywhere. The Bridge SDK is used by over 3,500 developers for game publishing and offers distribution across 15 platforms.

### Complete Documentation
- [Main Documentation](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama): Complete SDK documentation and integration guides
- [Getting Started Guide](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/getting-started): Step-by-step integration tutorial
- [Quick Start Tutorial](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/quick-start): Fast-track game publishing guide
- [Game Requirements](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/game-requirments): Platform standards and guidelines
- [Youtube Playables Requirements](https://wiki.playgama.com/platforms/youtube-playables-requirements-for-games): Youtube Platform requirements and guidelines

### Supported Game Engines & Integration
The Bridge SDK supports 8 major game development frameworks:

#### Plain JavaScript
- [Documentation](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/core-plain-js/intro): Core JavaScript implementation guide
- Framework-agnostic solution
- Direct integration without additional tools

#### Unity Engine
- [Documentation](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/unity/intro): Complete Unity WebGL integration guide
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/playgama/bridge-unity): Unity Bridge SDK source code and examples
- WebGL build support

#### Construct 3
- [Documentation](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/construct-3/intro): Visual scripting integration guide
- Easy drag-and-drop integration
- Visual scripting compatibility

#### Godot Engine (3.x & 4.x)
- [Documentation](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/godot/intro): Plugin-based integration guide
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/playgama/bridge-godot): Godot Bridge SDK source code
- [Asset Library](https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/3394): Official Godot Asset Library entry

#### GDevelop
- [Documentation](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/gdevelop/intro): Extension-based integration guide
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/playgama/bridge-gdevelop): GDevelop Bridge SDK source code
- Community-maintained extension

#### Game Maker Studio
- [Documentation](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/game-maker/intro): Complete Game Maker integration guide
- HTML5 export compatibility
- GML script support

#### Defold Engine
- [Documentation](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/defold/intro): Native Defold integration guide
- HTML5 build support
- Lua scripting compatibility

#### Cocos Creator
- [Documentation](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/cocos-creator/intro): TypeScript and JavaScript integration guide
- TypeScript and JavaScript support
- Cross-platform development

- **Discord** - Social network for gamers
- **Facebook Gaming** - Facebook's gaming platform

#### Major Gaming Portals
- **Crazygames** - One of the leading gaming platforms, boasting millions of active users worldwide
- **MSN Games** - Microsoft's gaming portal
- **Microsoft Store** - Microsoft's gaming store for Microsoft devices

#### Telecom Platforms
- **Xiaomi** - Mobile ecosystem with Game Center app, millions of devices worldwide
- **Oppo** - Mobile ecosystem and Gaming app across Asia and emerging markets
- **Huawei** - AppGallery and HMS ecosystem, major presence in China and globally
- **Samsung* - Samsung Instant Plays and Gaming Hub App, pre-installed on the world’s largest fleet of Android devices

### SDK Features & Capabilities

#### Core Functionality
- **Single Integration**: One SDK for all platforms
- **Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Seamless operation across all supported platforms
- **Automatic Platform Detection**: SDK automatically adapts to the hosting platform
- **Revenue Optimization**: Built-in monetization across all platforms

#### Monetization Features
- **In-Game Purchases**: Features in-game purchase functionality for monetisation across all supported platforms
- **Advertisement Integration**: Automatic ad placement and optimization
- **Banner Ads**: Customizable banner advertisement support
- **Interstitial Ads**: Full-screen advertisement between game sessions
- **Rewarded Video Ads**: Player-initiated ads for in-game rewards
- **Superstitial Ads**: Display superstitial ads at the start of the game

#### Player Management
- **User Authentication**: Platform-specific login systems
- **Profile Management**: Player data and progress tracking
- **Social Features**: Friend systems and social interactions
- **Achievement Systems**: Cross-platform achievement tracking
- **Leaderboards**: Global and platform-specific rankings

#### Data & Analytics
- **Cloud Saves**: Cross-device progress synchronization
- **Storage Management**: Local and cloud-based data storage
- **Analytics Integration**: Detailed player behavior tracking
- **Performance Metrics**: Game performance and engagement data
- **A/B Testing**: Built-in testing capabilities for optimization

#### Technical Features
- **Device Detection**: Automatic device type recognition (mobile, tablet, desktop, TV)
- **Platform APIs**: Access to platform-specific functionality
- **Remote Configuration**: Dynamic game configuration updates
- **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error tracking and reporting
- **Quality Assurance Tools**: Built-in testing and debugging features

### Latest SDK Updates (v1.30.0)

#### Advertisement module
– Added advanced banners for Playgama, CrazyGames, MSN
– Added a delay before showing interstitial ads at game start for MSN, Xiaomi, Y8
– Improved adblock detection

#### Platform module
– Added sendCustomMessage method

#### YouTube
– Updated integration
– Added advertisement.showRewarded support

#### Other improvements
– Improved Xiaomi integration
– Improved QA Tool integration
– Minor bug fixes
